children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions summarized CEO Steve Reinharz's investor AMA highlighting ROAMEO scale plans, capital needs and operational cash‑flow targets.
CEO Reinharz summarized a Sept 2 investor AMA covering PURSUON, ROAMEO production, demand and management objectives.
Company says demand is not the constraint; capital and manufacturing throughput limit ROAMEO fleet growth.
Targets ~ $200,000/month of added recurring revenue and ~ $200,000/month of cost reductions by Dec 2026 to reach positive operational cash flow.
Reiterated goal of deploying 50 ROAMEO units by Aug 2027, contingent on capital and customer site readiness.
Noted dilution mainly from 2026 financing arrangements converting now; prior August 2026 operational cash‑flow target was missed due to lower sales.
